title: fusion.entry-request/v1
description: fusion's proposal in request 76, not yet accepted by Prior: the invocation input of fusion.entry.v1 and the role input of its run step, both bound by workflows/entry.v1.json whatever the entry's profile declares (decision 261023-1854-which-schemas-bind-an-entry-run-of-an-agent-that-is-also-a-workflow-role, option 1). Composition is trusted host code: workflow_id is the host-minted identity of this invocation, which every host service call carries beside identity (request 69's common pair, and the binding of Prior's entry calls); run_id is the one host-provisioned run, revise_bound being 0; entry names the catalog entry and the profile the run takes its role from; arguments are the values admission checked against the entry's argument declaration; project_context is host-added as in the explorer role input. The host freezes the composed object through host.role.compose.v1 and the same bytes travel as RoleCall.input on every role call of the run. audit_ref is the host's recovery overlay: absent at preparation and in every frozen role input, set on a fresh outer operation after a recorded recovery, and sent by the module only as RoleCall.audit_ref to host.role.complete.v1. No $schema keyword: the host compiles every bundle schema as draft 2020-12 and this file must carry no URL.

workflow_id.description: Host-minted, the identity of this invocation; the operation id of every request-69 service call is derived from it.

run_id.description: The host-provisioned run; the module creates none. Bounded to 64 characters so that the role operation id, capability + ":" + run_id, fits the SDK's limit.

entry.description: The catalog entry this run serves. id and kind equal the catalog entry's; profile equals its profile, the role the run step takes from the invocation. The module checks all three against the catalog before any call.

arguments.description: The admitted arguments, in the order given; each name is one the entry's argument declaration lists, which JSON Schema cannot state and admission checks (unknown-argument). A flag's value is the empty string, its presence being the flag. Empty when the entry was started without arguments.

project_context.description: Host-added: the project instruction files the host selected, root AGENTS.md falling back to CLAUDE.md, empty when neither exists; the shape of the explorer role input's project_context.

path.description: Repository-relative, no traversal, each path once.

sha256.description: Over the supplied UTF-8 bytes of text, in the host's sha256:<hex> form.

route.description: The route the run is admitted on, when the operator named one; a route the entry is not qualified on is refused at admission (route-not-qualified). A dispatched child runs on its parent's route and carries none of its own.

audit_ref.description: A host-recorded recovery audit reference for the run standing at answered; sent only to its completion. Its presence never changes the frozen role input, which never carries it.
